title: Cherry Berry Ice E-Liquid 60ml (3000mg)
description:
Introducing our tantalizing trio of flavours in our latest CBD E-Liquid collection: Red Berries, Cherries, and Menthol. Crafted with precision and care, each blend promises a refreshing and indulgent vaping experience.
Our CBD E-liquid boasts an 80% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 20% VG (Vegetable Glycerin) composition, ensuring a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. The Cherry Berry Ice flavour is a whimsical journey into the sweet nostalgia of Cherry, Berries and Menthol, providing a luscious and enjoyable cloud with every inhale.
Find the ultimate way to relax with each puff of our Cherry Berry Ice CBD E liquid – where tranquility meets taste in a bottle designed for your ultimate enjoyment.
